rows.grounds: ablative of cause/means; act of reciting the kavaca
ablative of cause/means; act of holding or wearing the kavaca
compound denoting rulers of the directions

items.question: What exalted status did the gods attain through reciting and wearing this armor?
premises: Reciting and wearing the kavaca confer transformative power.
The gods engaged in reciting and wearing the kavaca.
Lords of the directions possess sovereign rulership.
items.inference: Therefore, through reciting and wearing the kavaca, the gods became lords of the directions.
items.plain_english: Through recitation and wearing, the gods became lords of the directions.
